highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 and modernizes support across several platforms.
highlights_body: Uno applications move to Uno Platform 7, Apple native assets have newer deployment baselines, and WebAssembly WebGPU linking is simplified. The release also fixes Unicode character-code validation, native data creation, buffered streams, and Android texture synchronization.

bullets.lead: Skia m156 includes current upstream fixes
bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the current m156 upstream bug-fix set.
Character-code APIs now validate encoded code-unit sizes correctly and report consistent argument exceptions for invalid input.

bullets.lead: Native data and buffered streams handled safely
bullets.detail: Creating SKData from C strings avoids reading past the native buffer, and front-buffered streams no longer retain their input unnecessarily.
Android texture rendering now follows the display refresh cycle for more reliable presentation.

bullets.lead: Managed pixel and text-shaping allocations reduced
bullets.detail: Image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 conversion, and feature-string decoding avoid unnecessary managed or native allocations.

bullets.lead: Uno WinUI views updated for Uno Platform 7
bullets.detail: The Uno views package and samples adopt Uno Platform 7's unified renderer and .NET 10 baseline while retaining a CPU fallback where a swap chain is unavailable.

bullets.lead: Native assets align with current platform toolchains
bullets.detail: Windows dependencies, GN, Visual Studio, ANGLE, and Apple native deployment baselines are updated for current supported build environments.
The WebGPU C++ support is bundled into the native archive, so consumer WebAssembly links no longer compile it alongside application code.

bullets.lead: Bundled HarfBuzz functions load locally on Linux
bullets.detail: Linux native packages bind their bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, preventing symbol conflicts with an application's installed HarfBuzz library.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Updated Uno WinUI support for Uno Platform 7 and bundled the WebGPU C++ support in WebAssembly native assets
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bound bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux and stabilized Blazor CPU sample tests
contributor_summaries.akoeplinger: Retired the unused Azure DevOps Dependabot configuration
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual PoliCheck findings in continuous integration
